upstream.author: kleeder
upstream.name: Pixel Rainfall
upstream.description: Written in collaboration with damifortune. NES format (.nsf) converted to bytebeat. Used a lua script to log the APU into .csv while playing back the .nsf in fceux. Then .csv converted by a python script into a javascript array. The js logic is going through the array data and converts it on the fly for 4 channels.
